pkgmetadata.longdescription: Mixture-of-experts coding models (35B total, about 3B active per token) quantized to GGUF, pinned to upstream Hugging Face revisions and installed under /usr/share/gguf, where qinda-llm-server serves them with llama.cpp. Nothing is downloaded at run time.

use.flag: Install Ornith 1.5 35B-A3B at Q5_K_M (25.3 GB), the default coding model
Install Qwen3.6 35B-A3B at UD-Q5_K_XL (26.6 GB), an alternative (off by default)
